description: REQUIRES prior nps_edi__auth__npki_session__login call with same account_link_id. Issue the NPS membership certificate (EC02, Korean only) for one subscriber. IRREVERSIBLE: the certificate is issued at 국민연금공단 and stays in the application results list; there is no cancel action. An issued certificate can be printed again only within 24 hours; after that a new application must be sent first. This writes to the institution. The first call is not executed: it returns a preview of exactly what will be sent and a one-time confirmation_token (error WRITE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED). Show that preview to the user as it is. Only after the user agrees, call again with the same arguments plus that confirmation_token. Never add the token without the user's agreement. Changing any argument makes the token invalid; call without the token to get a new preview. 호출마다 토큰 1소진 요청 처리 시 XBOSS 작업을 생성하고 처리 결과를 저장합니다. 기관 원본의 조회 여부와 별개로 이 호출은 순수 읽기 전용이 아닙니다. 기관 데이터 변경은 도구별 실행 내용과 기존 확인 절차를 따릅니다.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

confirmation_token.description: One-time confirmation token returned by the first call (error WRITE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED). Send it back unchanged with the same arguments to execute; it expires in 10 minutes and works once.

language.description: Certificate language. Only ko (Korean) is issued; omit it.

member_name.description: Subscriber name. If several share it, pass row_index or row_key instead.

row_index.description: options[].row_index from the subscribers list tool

row_key.description: options[].row_key from the subscribers list tool
